Founded in 1983, The Ohio State Biochemistry Program (OSBP) is a campus-wide graduate program that has granted over 385 PhD degrees. With 80 faculty currently in the program, OSBP offers a wide range of research opportunities spanning all areas of biochemistry, including Molecular Basis of Disease, Chemical Biology and Enzymes, Structural Biology, and Molecular Biology and Genetics.
